text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The perfect day off.
It couldn't possibly get any better than this.
choice_data_list: You're in quite a good mood.
You're in quite a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
I went to a cat cafe and played with the kitties.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"The white kitty that rubbed against my legs!
The black-spotted kitty that curled up on my lap!
The ginger tabby kitty that licked my fingers!!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A true paradise! A utopia full of cats!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Aah, just thinking about it makes my head feel pure bliss!
Cats! Cats are the bestーーーー!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Calstone Light O
had a very fulfilling day off!
